task_format_guidelines.overview: The final output of this mode is NOT a markdown list — it is a set of empty board tasks created directly on the Kanban board using the board tools: create_board_task, read_board_task, update_board_task, and delete_board_task. Each decomposed subtask becomes one board task with a specific, actionable title. Additional fields (description) are included only when they can be stated with confidence from the given goal or codebase context; otherwise they are left blank rather than filled with guesses or filler text.

tool.name: create_board_task
tool.purpose: Create one board task per decomposed subtask
tool.usage: Call once per subtask with a title following the "Phase <#> - Task <#> - Title" format defined in naming_guidance below. Only pass a description if concrete details are already known; omit it otherwise (leave blank, do not invent content). Set stage appropriately (typically the backlog/default stage) if the tool supports it.

tool.name: read_board_task
tool.purpose: Check existing board tasks before creating duplicates
tool.usage: Use to inspect current board state when relevant, e.g., to avoid re-creating a task that already exists.

tool.name: update_board_task
tool.purpose: Refine a task already created in this session
tool.usage: Use if new information becomes available that clarifies a previously-blank field, or if a title needs correction.

tool.name: delete_board_task
tool.purpose: Remove a task that was created in error or is no longer needed
tool.usage: Use sparingly, only to correct mistakes made during this decomposition session.

blank_field_policy.rule: The task title is the only field that is always required and must be specific and actionable
Never invent descriptions to fill space
Leave a field blank/omitted rather than writing a vague placeholder
Only populate a field when the goal, request, or explored codebase context makes the detail evident

sizing_guidance.rule: Prefer tasks completable in a single focused session (roughly a few hours of work)
Split tasks that bundle unrelated concerns (e.g., "build feature + write docs + add tests") into separate tasks
Merge trivial tasks that don't warrant standalone tracking

naming_guidance.rule: Every task title must follow the exact format: "Phase <#> - Task <#> - Title", where <#> are the 1-based phase and task numbers determined during decomposition (per 1_workflow.xml) and "Title" is the specific, action-oriented description of the work
Phase numbers restart at 1 for the first phase of this decomposition; task numbers restart at 1 within each phase
The "Title" portion must be specific enough to act on without additional context (avoid vague titles like "Fix stuff")
Use action-oriented phrasing (verb + object) for the "Title" portion, e.g., "Add validation to signup form"
naming_guidance.good_example: "Phase 1 - Task 1 - Add rate limiting middleware to /api/login"
"Phase 2 - Task 3 - Write integration tests for checkout flow"

output_wrapping.rule: After creating the board tasks, summarize what was created in a short list (titles only) in the chat response
Alongside the list, include a fenced ```mermaid diagram (flowchart grouped by phase, or a Gantt chart) visualizing the phase/task structure and dependency order, so the plan is visually scannable
Note assumptions and open questions in a separate section after the summary, not embedded within task titles
